item.title: Ask for Help
item.description: One thing people sometimes forget you can always ask for external help. It’s not always necessary to come up with a solution yourself. If you feel like you’re stuck in something, then it’s worth asking for help from the experienced one. It’s necessary and essential to learn how to ask for help. And another thing to master is handle rejection. We all are not very good with rejection. But you gotta learn…
